sentences.text:
Author: Ninala Jayasurya
Bench: Ninala Jayasurya
 Honourable Sri Justice Ninala Jayasurya
 Criminal Petition No.2820 of 2020
Order:
(Heard and pronounced through Blue Jeans App (Virtual) mode, since this mode is adopted on account of prevalence of COVID-19 pandemic.)
Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Assistant Public Prosecutor representing learned Public Prosecutor.

This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 seeking to quash all further proceedings in F.I.R. No.716 of 2019, dated 13.12.2019 on the file of Station House Officer, Anakapalli Town Police Station, Visakhapatnam, against the petitioner/ accused No.5.
The petitioner is accused No.5 in Crime No.716 of 2019.

The said crime has been registered against the petitioner and others for the alleged offences punishable under Sections 307, 353, 328, 270, 273 read with Sections 34 and 109 of IPC and Section 59(1) of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

When the matter is taken up for consideration, learned counsel for the petitioner submits that on the earlier occasion in respect of accused No.3, Criminal Petition No.12 of 2020 has been filed and this Court by an order dated 28.01.2020 was pleased to quash the FIR following the orders passed in Criminal Petition No.3731 of 2018 and batch cases.

Since the issue involved in the present case is identical to the Criminal Petition No.3731 of 2018 and batch cases as well as in Criminal Petition No.12 of 2020 and the orders passed thereon squarely applies to the present case on hand, this Court following the said orders and in terms thereof, is inclined to allow the Criminal Petition partly.

Accordingly, the Criminal Petition is partly allowed quashing all the further proceedings against the petitioner/A.5 in FIR No.716 of 2019 on the file of Station House Officer, Anakapalli Town Police Station, Visakhapatnam District, registered insofar as the offences punishable under Sections 353,
328, 270, 273 read with Sections 34 and 109 of IPC and Section 59(1) of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, but not under Section 307 of IPC.
